title: LDBC recursive query isolation harness

steps.step: Add repeatable disable-read-query support to LDBC native smoke
Mark disabled-query LDBC runs as isolation-only gap evidence
Expose isolation mode in external smoke and production gate checks
Run Query 14 and Query 13/14 isolation commands to find next blockers
Run Query 12/13/14 isolation command to verify pass-prevention marker
Document recursive CTE coverage and diagnosis-only semantics

evidence.py_compile: python -m py_compile ldbc_snb_native_smoke.py external_smoke.py bench_gate.py external_bootstrap.py: passed

discoveries: Disabling LdbcQuery14 exposes LdbcQuery13 as the next dynamic blocker.
Disabling LdbcQuery13 and LdbcQuery14 exposes LdbcQuery12 as the next dynamic blocker.
Disabling LdbcQuery12, LdbcQuery13, and LdbcQuery14 lets the 10-operation sample complete LdbcQuery1 and LdbcQuery11, but the harness correctly reports gap because isolation_mode=true.
Official PostgreSQL implementation recursive CTE use appears in complex queries 12, 13, 14 and short queries 2, 6.
remaining_blockers: LDBC WITH RECURSIVE support across Query 12, Query 13, Query 14, Short Query 2, and Short Query 6
Post-recursive Query 14 PostgreSQL SQL coverage: arrays, generate_subscripts, row_number window function, and nested aggregation
next_task: BENCHPROD-102: implement bounded recursive CTE support or a semantically equivalent LDBC adapter path
